stages.title: Raw sources
stages.text: Open data as downloaded, with the licence recorded in the source registry.

datasets.name: HEAPO
datasets.publisher: ETH Zurich (Brudermueller; Fleisch; Gonzalez Vaya; Staake)

datasets.name: Dataset on residential electricity load profiles in Switzerland (ETH/EKZ)
datasets.publisher: ETH Zurich + EKZ (Kaiser; Kreft; Gonzalez Vaya; Hug)

datasets.name: MeteoSwiss OGD automatic weather stations (ogd-smn)
datasets.licence: CC BY 4.0; citation "Source: MeteoSwiss" required; must not imply MeteoSwiss endorsement (terms page read 2026-11-17: opendatadocs.meteoswiss.ch/general/terms-of-use)

datasets.name: Hourly GHG emission factors of the Swiss mix 2016-2017 (Vuarnoz & Aguacil Moreno 2020)
datasets.licence: CC BY 4.0 (dataset page); article is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0

datasets.name: Energy-Charts API (public_power, cbpf) for CH, FR, DE, AT, IT
datasets.licence: CC BY 4.0 with attribution "energy-charts.info" (stated in API docs; checked 2026-11-17: /v2 responses for public_power CH DE FR AT IT and cbpf CH carry a license field stating CC BY 4.0 with attribution energy-charts.info; the /v1 responses used for the download have no license field)

datasets.name: Energy-Charts day-ahead spot price Switzerland 2023 (API /price?bzn=CH)
datasets.publisher: Fraunhofer ISE (energy-charts.info); data from Bundesnetzagentur | SMARD.de
datasets.licence: CC BY 4.0 from Bundesnetzagentur | SMARD.de, stated in the API documentation (openapi.json, path /price), checked 2026-11-18

datasets.name: Climate CH2025 DAILY-LOCAL, station Zuerich / Kloten (KLO): tas, tasmin, tasmax, rsds, hurs for the reference 1991-2020 and the global warming levels 1.5, 2.0 and 3.0 C (20 CSV files) plus the station and parameter metadata (2 files)
datasets.licence: CC BY 4.0 (file header and STAC collection); required citation: MeteoSwiss & ETH Zurich (2025): Climate CH2025 - Daily Datasets. Federal Office of Meteorology and Climatology MeteoSwiss, Zurich, https://doi.org/10.18751/climate/scenarios/ch2025/data/1.0/

stages.title: Canonical datasets
stages.text: Cleaned hourly series for six buildings, weather, tariff, carbon intensity and PV, each with a quality-control report.

datasets.name: Six-building hourly datasets (2023)
Zurich/Kloten hourly weather 2023
EKZ standard tariff 2023 hourly (energy + grid)
Modeled hourly Swiss electricity carbon intensity 2023 (consumption-based lifecycle + domestic diagnostic)
datasets.licence: derived from SRC-011 (CC BY 4.0; attribution energy-charts.info); emission factors IPCC AR5 WG3 Annex III Table A.III.2

datasets.name: Assumed-PV hourly AC output per kWp 2023 and capacity table

Hourly scenario weather for Kloten: typical warmed years gwl1.5, gwl2.0, gwl3.0 and heat-wave variants hist_hw, gwl2.0_hw, gwl3.0_hw (95th percentile spells) and hist_hw99, gwl2.0_hw99, gwl3.0_hw99 (99th percentile spells)
datasets.licence: derived from SRC-014 (CC BY 4.0, CH2025 citation required) and DER-007 (MeteoSwiss)

stages.title: Building and heat-pump model
stages.text: Heat demand is calculated from heat-pump electricity and outdoor temperature; a simple RC model gives indoor temperature.

datasets.name: Derived heating and DHW thermal demand (2023 hourly)
datasets.licence: inherits CC BY 4.0 (source data); literature parameters cited

datasets.name: RC thermal parameters 2023 (quasi-steady fit of the derived heat and pooled-prior effective areas)

stages.title: CityLearn environment
stages.text: Schema and building files that CityLearn 3.3.0 runs, extended step by step with PV, a battery, the RC model and climate cells.

datasets.name: CityLearn dataset swiss_district_2023 (schema.json + 6 building CSVs + weather + pricing)
CityLearn dataset swiss_pv_2023 (DER-010 plus assumed PV, ratio 1.0)
CityLearn dataset swiss_pvbat_2023 (DER-013 plus assumed battery 1 kWh/kWp)
CityLearn dataset swiss_rc_2023 (DER-014 plus RC thermal model per building)

CityLearn climate cell datasets <scenario>_<adoption> (S3 district: assumed PV, battery, RC building, scenario weather and PV, cooling device in the cooled buildings): 6 weather scenarios x adoption none, low, medium, high, plus high_alt for the two 3.0 C scenarios and the p95 and 1.5 C sensitivities on request
datasets.licence: inherits CC BY 4.0 + MeteoSwiss and CH2025 citations

stages.title: Controllers
stages.text: Thermostat reference, hand-set rules, a planner (MPC), learning controllers and the exact optimum, judged on the same weeks.

stages.title: Audit bundle and dashboard
stages.text: Every number is traced to its source in a provenance bundle that this site reads; a lint checks that the site and the bundle agree.
